5.odr_com: for because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my preceptes and commandements, and obserued my ceremonies & lawes.

7.s_dismas: Who when he was asked by the men of that place, concerning his wife, anſwered: She is my ſiſter; for he was afraid to confeſſe that ſhe was married to him, thinking leſt peraduenture that they would kil him becauſe of her beautie.
7.odr_com: Who when he was asked by the men of that place, concerning his wife, answered: She is my sister. for he was afraid to confesse that she was married to him, thinking lest peraduenture they would kil him because of her beautie.
7.sabates_a: Who when he was asked by the men of that place concerning his wife, answered: She is my sister; for he was afraid to confess that she was married to him, thinking lest peradventure they would kill him because of her beauty.

8.s_dismas: And when verie manie days were paſſed, and he abode there, Abimelech the king of the Paleſtines looking forth through a windowe, ſawe him ſporting with Rebecca his wife.
8.odr_com: And when verie manie days were passed, and he abode there, Abimelech the king of the Palestines looking forth through a windowe, sawe him sporting with Rebecca his wife.
8.sabates_a: And when very many days were passed, & he abode there, Abimelech the king of the Palestines looking forth through a window saw him sporting with Rebecca his wife.

9.s_dismas: And calling for him, he ſaid: It is euident that ſhe is thy wife: why dideſt thou faine her to be thy ſiſter? He anſwered: I feared leſt I ſhould die for her.
9.odr_com: And calling for him, he said: It is euident that she is thy wife: why didest thou faine her to be thy sister? He answered: I feared lest I should die for her.
9.sabates_a: And calling for him, he said: it is evident that she is thy wife: why didst thou feign her to be thy sister? He answered: I feared lest I should die for her.
9.madueke_b: And calling for him, he said: it is evident that she is thy wife: why didst thou feign her to be thy sister? He answered: I feared lest I should die for her.

10.s_dismas: And Abimelech ſaid: Why haſt thou deceaued vs? ſome man of the people might haue lyen with thy wife, & thou haddeſt brought vpon vs a great ſinne. And he commanded al the people, ſaying:
10.odr_com: And Abimelech said: Why hast thou deceaued vs? some man of the people might haue lyen with thy wife, & thou haddest brought vpon vs a great sinne. And he commanded al the people, saying:
10.sabates_a: And Abimelech said: Why hast thou deceived us? Some man of the people might have lien with thy wife, and thou hadst brought upon us a great sin. And he commanded all the people, saying:
10.madueke_b: And Abimelech said: Why hast thou deceived us? Some man of the people might have lien with thy wife, and thou hadst brought upon us a great sin. And he commanded all the people, saying:

11.s_dismas: He that ſhal touch this mans wife, dying ſhal dye.
11.odr_com: He that shal touch this mans wife, dying shal dye.
11.sabates_a: He that shall touch this man's wife, dying shall die.
11.madueke_b: He that shall touch this man's wife, dying shall die.

12.s_dismas: And Iſaac ſowed in that land, and he found that ſame year an hundred fold: and our Lord bleſſed him.
12.odr_com: And Isaac sowed in that land, and he found that same yeare an hundred fold: and our Lord blessed him.
12.sabates_a: And Isaac sowed in that land, and he found that same year and hundred fold: and our Lord blessed him.
12.madueke_b: And Isaac sowed in that land, and he found that same year and hundred fold: and our Lord blessed him.

13.s_dismas: And the man was made rich, and he went proſpering and encreaſing, til he was made exceeding great:
13.odr_com: And the man was made rich, and he went prospering and encreasing, til he was made exceeding great:
13.sabates_a: And the man was made rich, and he went prospering and increasing, till he was made exceeding great:
13.madueke_b: And the man was made rich, and he went prospering and increasing, till he was made exceeding great:

14.s_dismas: and he had alſo poſſeſſions of ſheep and of heards, and a verie great familie. For this the Paleſtines enuying him,
14.odr_com: and he had also possessions of sheep and of heards, and a verie great familie. For this the Palestines enuying him,
14.sabates_a: and he had also possessions of sheep and of herds, and a very great family. For this the Palestines envying him,
14.madueke_b: and he had also possessions of sheep and of herds, and a very great family. For this the Palestines envying him,

15.s_dismas: ſtopped at that time al the welles, that the ſeruants of his father Abraham had digged; filling them vp with water:
15.odr_com: stopped at that time al the welles, that the seruants of his father Abraham had digged, filling them vp with water:
15.sabates_a: stopped at that time all the wells, that the servants of his father Abraham had digged, filling them up with earth:
15.madueke_b: stopped at that time all the wells, that the servants of his father Abraham had digged, filling them up with earth:

16.s_dismas: in ſo much that Abimelech himſelfe ſaid to Iſaac: Depart from vs, becauſe thou art become mightier then we a great deale.
16.odr_com: in so much that Abimelech himselfe said to Isaac: Depart from vs, because thou art become mightier then we a great deale.
16.sabates_a: in so much that Abimelech himself said to Isaac: Depart from us, because thou art become mightier than we a great deal.
16.madueke_b: in so much that Abimelech himself said to Isaac: Depart from us, because thou art become mightier than we a great deal.

17.s_dismas: And departing, to come to the Torrent of Gerara, and to dwel there:
17.odr_com: And departing, to come to the Torrent of Gerara, and to dwel there:
17.sabates_a: And departing, to come to the Torrent of Gerara, and to dwell there,
17.madueke_b: And departing, to come to the Torrent of Gerara, and to dwell there,

18.s_dismas: againe he digged other welles, which the ſeruants of his father Abraham had digged, and which after his death, the Philiſtines had ſtopped vp of old: and the called them by the ſame names, which his father before had called them.
18.odr_com: againe he digged other welles, which the seruants of his father Abraham had digged, and which, after his death, the Philistines had stopped vp of old: and he called them by the same names, which his father before had called them.
18.sabates_a: again he digged other wells, which the servants of his father Abraham had digged, and which after his death the Philistines had stopped up of old: & he called them by the same names which his father before had called them.
18.madueke_b: again he digged other wells, which the servants of his father Abraham had digged, and which after his death the Philistines had stopped up of old: & he called them by the same names which his father before had called them.

19.s_dismas: And they digged in the Torrent, and found liuing water:
19.odr_com: And they digged in the Torrent, and found liuing water:
19.sabates_a: And they digged in the Torrent, and found living water:
19.madueke_b: And they digged in the Torrent, and found living water:

20.s_dismas: but there alſo the paſtors of Gerara made a brawle againſt the paſtors of Iſaac, ſaying: It is our water. For which cauſe he called the name of the wel, by occaſion of VVrangling. that which had hapned, Calumne.
20.odr_com: but there also the pastors of Gerara made a brawle against the pastors of Isaac, saying: It is our water. for which cause he called the name of the wel, by occasion of that which had hapned, Calumne.
20.sabates_a: but there also the pastors of Gerara made a brawl against the pastors of Isaac, saying: it is our water. For which cause he called the name of the well, by occasion of that which had happened, Calumny.
20.madueke_b: but there also the pastors of Gerara made a brawl against the pastors of Isaac, saying: it is our water. For which cause he called the name of the well, by occasion of that which had happened, Calumny.

21.s_dismas: And they digged alſo an other: & for that they brawled likewiſe, and he called the name of it,
21.odr_com: And they digged also an other: & for that they brawled likewise, and he called the name of it, Enmitie.
21.sabates_a: And they digged also another; and for that they brawled likewise, and he called the name of it, Enmity.
21.madueke_b: And they digged also another; and for that they brawled likewise, and he called the name of it, Enmity.

22.s_dismas: Enmitie. Going foreward from thence he digged an other wel, for which they contended not: therfore he called the name therof, Latitude, ſaying: Now hath the Loed dilated vs, and made vs to encreaſe vpon the earth.
22.odr_com: Going foreward from thence he digged an other wel, for which they contended not: therfore he called the name therof, Latitude, saying: Now hath our Lord dilated vs, and made vs to encrease vpon the earth.
22.sabates_a: Going forward from thence he digged another well, for which they contended not: therefore he called the name thereof, Latitude, saying: Now hath our Lord dilated us, and made us to increase upon the earth.
22.madueke_b: Going forward from thence he digged another well, for which they contended not: therefore he called the name thereof, Latitude, saying: Now hath our Lord dilated us, and made us to increase upon the earth.

23.s_dismas: And he went vp from that place vnto Berſabee,
23.odr_com: And he went vp from that place vnto Bersabee,
23.sabates_a: And he went up from that place unto Bersabee,
23.madueke_b: And he went up from that place unto Bersabee,

24.s_dismas: where our Lord appeared to him that ſame night, ſaying: I am the God of Abraham thy father, do not feare, becauſe I am with thee I wil bleſſe thee, and multiplie thy ſeed for my ſeruant Abrahams ſake.
24.odr_com: where our Lord appeared to him that same night, saying: I am the God of Abraham thy father, do not feare, because I am with thee: I wil blesse thee, and multiplie thy seed for my seruant Abrahams sake.
24.sabates_a: Where our Lord appeared to him that same night, saying: I am the God of Abraham thy father, do not fear, because I am with thee: I will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
24.madueke_b: Where our Lord appeared to him that same night, saying: I am the God of Abraham thy father, do not fear, because I am with thee: I will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.

25.s_dismas: Therfore he builded there an altar: and hauing called vpon the name of our Lord, he pitched his tent: and commanded his ſeruants that they ſhould digge a wel.
25.odr_com: Therfore he builded there an altar: and hauing called vpon the name of our Lord, he pitched his tent: and commanded his seruants that they should digge a wel.
25.sabates_a: Therefore he builded there an altar: and having called upon the name of our Lord, he pitched his tent: & commanded his servants that they should dig a well.
25.madueke_b: Therefore he builded there an altar: and having called upon the name of our Lord, he pitched his tent: & commanded his servants that they should dig a well.

26.s_dismas: To the which place when there were come from Gerara Abimelech, and Ocazath his freind, and Phicol chieffe captaine of his ſouldiers,
26.odr_com: To the which place when there were come from Gerara Abimelech, and Ocozath his freind, and Phicol chieffe captaine of his souldiers,
26.sabates_a: To the which place when there were come from Gerara Abimelech, and Ocozath his friend, & Phicol chief Captain of his soldiers,
26.madueke_b: To the which place when there were come from Gerara Abimelech, and Ocozath his friend, & Phicol chief Captain of his soldiers,

27.s_dismas: Iſaac ſpake to them: Why are you come to me a man whom you hated, and haue thruſt from you?
27.odr_com: Isaac spake to them: Why are ye come to me a man whom you hated, and haue thrust our from you?
27.sabates_a: Isaac spake to them: Why are ye come to me a man whom you hated, and have thrust out from you?
27.madueke_b: Isaac spake to them: Why are ye come to me a man whom you hated, and have thrust out from you?

28.s_dismas: Who anſwered: We ſaw that the Lord is with thee, and therfore we ſaid: Let there be an oath betwen vs, and let vs make a league,
28.odr_com: Who answered: We saw that the Lord is with thee, and therfore we said: Let there be an oath betwen vs, and let vs make a league,
28.sabates_a: Who answered: We saw that the Lord is with thee, and therefore we said: Let there be an oath between us, and let us make a league,
28.madueke_b: Who answered: We saw that the Lord is with thee, and therefore we said: Let there be an oath between us, and let us make a league,

29.s_dismas: that thou du vs no harme, as we alſo haue touched nothing of thine, neither haue we done that which might hurt thee: but with peace haue we diſmiſt thee encreaſed with the bleſſing of the Lord.
29.odr_com: that thou do vs no harme, as we also haue touched nothing of thine, neither haue we done that which might hurt thee: but with peace haue we dismist thee encreased with the blessing of the Lord.
29.sabates_a: that thou do us no harm, as we also have touched nothing of thine, neither have we done that which might hurt thee: but with peace have we dismissed thee increased with the blessing of the Lord.
29.madueke_b: that thou do us no harm, as we also have touched nothing of thine, neither have we done that which might hurt thee: but with peace have we dismissed thee increased with the blessing of the Lord.

30.s_dismas: Therfore he made them a feaſt, and after they had eaten and drunken
30.odr_com: Therfore he made them a feast, and after they had eaten and drunken
30.sabates_a: Therefore he made them a feast, and after they had eaten and drunken,
30.madueke_b: Therefore he made them a feast, and after they had eaten and drunken,

31.s_dismas: ariſing in the morning, they ſware one to an other: and Iſaac diſmiſſed them peaceably into their place.
31.odr_com: arising in the morning, they sware one to an other: and Isaac dismissed them peaceably into their place.
31.sabates_a: Arising in the morning, they sware one to another: and Isaac dismissed them peaceably into their place.
31.madueke_b: Arising in the morning, they sware one to another: and Isaac dismissed them peaceably into their place.

32.s_dismas: And behold the ſame day came the ſeruants of Iſaac telling him of a wel, which they had digged, and ſaying: We haue found water.
32.odr_com: And behold the same day came the seruants of Isaac telling him of a wel, which they had digged, and saying: We haue found water.
32.sabates_a: And behold the same day came the servants of Isaac telling him of a well, which they had digged, and saying: We have found water.
32.madueke_b: And behold the same day came the servants of Isaac telling him of a well, which they had digged, and saying: We have found water.

33.s_dismas: Wherupon he called it Abundance: and the name of the citie was geuen Berſabee, euen vnto this preſent day.
33.odr_com: Wherupon he called it Abundance: and the name of the citie was geuen Bersabee, euen vnto this present day.
33.sabates_a: Whereupon he called it Abundance: and the name of the city was given Bersabee, even unto this present day.
33.madueke_b: Whereupon he called it Abundance: and the name of the city was given Bersabee, even unto this present day.

34.s_dismas: But Eſau being fourtie yeares old married wiues, Iudith the daughter of Beeri the Hethite, and Baſemath the daughter of Elon of the ſame place:
34.odr_com: But Esau being fourtie yeares old married wiues, Iudith the daughter of Beeri the Hethite, and Basemath the daughter of Elon of the same place:
34.sabates_a: But Esau being forty years old married wives, Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hethite, and Basemath the daughter of Elon of the same place:
34.madueke_b: But Esau being forty years old married wives, Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hethite, and Basemath the daughter of Elon of the same place:

35.s_dismas: both which had offended the mind of Iſaac and Rebecca.
35.odr_com: both which had offended the mind of Isaac and Rebecca.
35.sabates_a: Both which had offended the mind of Isaac and Rebecca.
35.madueke_b: Both which had offended the mind of Isaac and Rebecca.

janvier_by_verse.1: And when a famine was risen in the land, after that sterility that had chanced in the days of Abraham, Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Palestines into Gerara.
janvier_by_verse.2: And our Lord appeared to him, and said: Go not down into Ægypt, but rest in the land which I shall tell thee.
janvier_by_verse.3: And sojourn in it, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee: for to thee and to thy seed I will give all these countries, accomplishing the oath which I sware to Abraham thy father.
janvier_by_verse.4: And I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven: and I will give to thy posterity all these countries: and in thy seed Shall be Blessed All The Nations of The Earth,
janvier_by_verse.5: for because Abraham obeyed my voice, & kept my precepts and commandments, and observed my ceremonies and laws.
janvier_by_verse.7: Who when he was asked by the men of that place concerning his wife, answered: She is my sister; for he was afraid to confess that she was married to him, thinking lest peradventure they would kill him because of her beauty.
janvier_by_verse.8: And when very many days were passed, & he abode there, Abimelech the king of the Palestines looking forth through a window saw him sporting with Rebecca his wife.
janvier_by_verse.9: And calling for him, he said: it is evident that she is thy wife: why didst thou feign her to be thy sister? He answered: I feared lest I should die for her.
janvier_by_verse.10: And Abimelech said: Why hast thou deceived us? Some man of the people might have lien with thy wife, and thou hadst brought upon us a great sin. And he commanded all the people, saying:
janvier_by_verse.11: He that shall touch this man's wife, dying shall die.
janvier_by_verse.12: And Isaac sowed in that land, and he found that same year and hundred fold: and our Lord blessed him.
janvier_by_verse.13: And the man was made rich, and he went prospering and increasing, till he was made exceeding great:
janvier_by_verse.14: and he had also possessions of sheep and of herds, and a very great family. For this the Palestines envying him,
janvier_by_verse.15: stopped at that time all the wells, that the servants of his father Abraham had digged, filling them up with earth:
janvier_by_verse.16: in so much that Abimelech himself said to Isaac: Depart from us, because thou art become mightier than we a great deal.
janvier_by_verse.17: And departing, to come to the Torrent of Gerara, and to dwell there,
janvier_by_verse.18: again he digged other wells, which the servants of his father Abraham had digged, and which after his death the Philistines had stopped up of old: & he called them by the same names which his father before had called them.
janvier_by_verse.19: And they digged in the Torrent, and found living water:
janvier_by_verse.20: but there also the pastors of Gerara made a brawl against the pastors of Isaac, saying: it is our water. For which cause he called the name of the well, by occasion of that which had happened, Calumny.
janvier_by_verse.21: And they digged also another; and for that they brawled likewise, and he called the name of it, Enmity.
janvier_by_verse.22: Going forward from thence he digged another well, for which they contended not: therefore he called the name thereof, Latitude, saying: Now hath our Lord dilated us, and made us to increase upon the earth.
janvier_by_verse.23: And he went up from that place unto Bersabee,
janvier_by_verse.24: Where our Lord appeared to him that same night, saying: I am the God of Abraham thy father, do not fear, because I am with thee: I will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
janvier_by_verse.25: Therefore he builded there an altar: and having called upon the name of our Lord, he pitched his tent: & commanded his servants that they should dig a well.
janvier_by_verse.26: To the which place when there were come from Gerara Abimelech, and Ocozath his friend, & Phicol chief Captain of his soldiers,
janvier_by_verse.27: Isaac spake to them: Why are ye come to me a man whom you hated, and have thrust out from you?
janvier_by_verse.28: Who answered: We saw that the Lord is with thee, and therefore we said: Let there be an oath between us, and let us make a league,
janvier_by_verse.29: that thou do us no harm, as we also have touched nothing of thine, neither have we done that which might hurt thee: but with peace have we dismissed thee increased with the blessing of the Lord.
janvier_by_verse.30: Therefore he made them a feast, and after they had eaten and drunken,
janvier_by_verse.31: Arising in the morning, they sware one to another: and Isaac dismissed them peaceably into their place.
janvier_by_verse.32: And behold the same day came the servants of Isaac telling him of a well, which they had digged, and saying: We have found water.
janvier_by_verse.33: Whereupon he called it Abundance: and the name of the city was given Bersabee, even unto this present day.
janvier_by_verse.34: But Esau being forty years old married wives, Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hethite, and Basemath the daughter of Elon of the same place:
janvier_by_verse.35: Both which had offended the mind of Isaac and Rebecca.
